```{python} 
from freqtrade.configuration import Configuration
from freqtrade.enums import RunMode
from freqtrade.optimize.hyperopt.hyperopt import Hyperopt
from freqtrade.optimize.hyperopt_tools import HyperoptTools
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

run_hyperopt = False
hyperopt_file = "strategy_MyStrategy2_2026-03-22_19-39-23.fthypt"

user_data_path = Path("/home/gustav/projects/freqtrade_dir/user_data")
config = Configuration.from_files([user_data_path / "config.json"])  # type: ignore

if run_hyperopt:
    config["spaces"] = ["buy"]
    config["strategy"] = "FindEdge"
    config["hyperopt_loss"] = "OnlyProfitHyperOptLoss"
    config["epochs"] = 20
    config["hyperopt_min_trades"] = 2
    config["hyperopt_random_state"] = 42
    config["print_all"] = True
    config["runmode"] = RunMode.HYPEROPT

    hyp = Hyperopt(config)
    hyp.start()

    hyperopt_file = hyp.__dict__["results_file"].name
    hyperopt_file = "strategy_MyStrategy2_2026-03-22_19-39-23.fthypt"

hyperopt_path = user_data_path / "hyperopt_results" / hyperopt_file
config = Configuration.from_files([user_data_path / "config.json"])  # type: ignore

epochs = HyperoptTools.load_filtered_results(hyperopt_path, config)[0]

EPOCH_DROP = {
    "params_details",
    "params_not_optimized",
    "results_explanation",
    "results_metrics",
    "params_dict",
}
METRICS_DROP = {
    "trades",
    "best_pair",
    "worst_pair",
    "results_per_pair",
    "results_per_enter_tag",
    "exit_reason_summary",
    "mix_tag_stats",
    "left_open_trades",
    "daily_profit",
    "locks",
}

frames = []
for epoch in epochs:
    params_dict = epoch["params_dict"]
    results_metrics = epoch["results_metrics"]

    data = {
        **{k: v for k, v in params_dict.items()},
        **{k: v for k, v in epoch.items() if k not in EPOCH_DROP},
        **{k: v for k, v in results_metrics.items() if k not in METRICS_DROP},
    }
    frames.append(data)


df = pd.json_normalize(frames)
df["wl_ratio"] = df["wins"] / (df["wins"] + df["draws"] + df["losses"])

first_cols = [
    "is_best",
    "current_epoch",
    "total_trades",
    "wins",
    "draws",
    "losses",
    "wl_ratio",
    "profit_mean",
    "profit_total_abs",
    "profit_total",
    "holding_avg",
    "loss",
    "max_drawdown_abs",
    "max_drawdown_account",
]
cols = first_cols + df.columns.difference(first_cols).tolist()

df = df[cols]
```
